deckTitle: Internal Medicine Wrestling: The Multimorbid Melee

cards.power: The Fluid-Flood. Pelican can't push the water forward, so it backs up into the Lung-Balloons, cansing the Drown-Gasp.
cards.lore: When the Heart-Engine loses its Squeeze-Power, hydrostatic pressure forces fluid into the alveoli.
cards.gradeReason: Pelican drowning in its own backflood — instant CHF embodiment, zero explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: ink-wash watercolor. Subject: drowned pelican chest-deep in pink foam. Mood: soggy defeat.

cards.power: The Chses-Quiver. Raccoon makes the Atrial-Chambers twitch randomly. This stops the Steady-Drammer and creates Clot-Monsters.
cards.lore: Re-entrant electrical loops in the atria lead to an Irregularly-Irregular ventricular response.
cards.gradeReason: Raccoon drumming total chaos — atrial fibrillation as a performance, dead-on.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: frantic ink comic. Subject: raccoon smashing drum kit with jagged lightning. Mood: anarchic frenzy.

cards.power: The Oxygen-Starve. Shark bites down on a Coronary-Pipe, stopping the Fuci-Flow. The engine starts to Recrosis-Melt.
cards.lore: Plaque rupture leads to thrombus formation, cutting off blood supply.
cards.gradeReason: Shark on coronary pipe = STEMI. Visceral, immediate, no medical degree required.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: aggressive watercolor splatter. Subject: red shark biting a pipe gushing fire. Mood: crushing emergency.

cards.power: The Back-Splash. Every time the heart squeezes, Vulture lets half the blood leak backward into the Lung-Chambers.
cards.lore: Ioceapetent mitral valve leaflets allow retrograde flow during systels.
cards.gradeReason: Vulture letting blood spray backward — mitral regurgitation as character, totally embodiable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: anatomical horror watercolor. Subject: vulture perched on mitral valve spraying blood backward. Mood: leaking doom.

cards.power: The Air-Trap. Ox gets air in, but can't get Waste-Smoke out. He becomes Hyper-Inflated.
cards.lore: Loss of elastic recoil and airway narrowing leads to air trapping and chronic Acid-Base-War.
cards.gradeReason: Barrel-chested ox blowing smoke it can't exhale — COPD embodied in one image.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: smoky ink comic. Subject: bloated barrel-chested ox exhaling gray clouds with blocked nostrils. Mood: trapped and puffed.

cards.power: The Narrow-Clench. Spider weaves Muscle-Webs around the Airway-Tunnels, making every breath a Whistle-Scream.
cards.lore: Reversible bronchoconstriction triggered by Allergy-Alarms or Cold-Air-Sparks.
cards.gradeReason: Spider squeezing airway webs until the breath whistles — asthma as physical performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: purple-tinted comic ink. Subject: giant spider webbing pink bronchial tubes in a vise. Mood: claustrophobic wheeze.

cards.power: The Lung-Strike. Cobra travels from Leg-Veins and bites the Main-Lung-Pipe, stopping Gas-Exchange instantly.
cards.lore: DVT embolizes to the pulmonary arteries, causing a Dead-Space-Glitch.
cards.gradeReason: Cobra migrating leg-to-lung and biting the pipe — PE trajectory is the whole game.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: teal-green ink chase. Subject: cobra slithering up from leg veins to strike a glowing lung pipe. Mood: venomous ambush.

cards.power: The Alveoli-Gunk. Moni fills Lung-Balloons with Infection-Sludge, blocking Osyra-the-Oaygen.
cards.lore: Bacterial or viral invasion causes inflammatory exudate to fill the alveolar spaces.
cards.gradeReason: Monster pouring yellow sludge into alveoli — pneumonia as disgustingly playable villain.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: neon-sick watercolor. Subject: lime-green monster vomiting sludge into pink lung balloons. Mood: infectious horror.

cards.power: The Honey-Blood. Bear floods Blood-River with Sugar-Tokens, Caramelizing Nerves and Kidney-Filters.
cards.lore: Insulin resistance or deficiency leads to chronic hyperglycemia and microvascular damage.
cards.gradeReason: Honey-flooding concept is strong but caramelizing nerves needs a beat to fully land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: golden watercolor. Subject: dripping honey bear wading through amber blood river. Mood: sticky slow-burn damage.

cards.power: The Speed-Dial. Toad turns System-Velocity to 100 (Sweating/Racing) or 0 (Freezing/Sluggish).
cards.lore: Thyroid hormones regulate basal metabolic rate and the synthesis of Na+/K+ ATPases.
cards.gradeReason: Toad on a speed dial — hyper vs hypo brilliantly encoded in one dual-mode performer.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: split hot-cold comic. Subject: toad turning a giant dial between flames and ice. Mood: metabolic extremes.

cards.power: The Stress-Hump. Carries body through Long-Sieges. Too much = Moon-Face-Buffer; Too little = Pressure-Crash.
cards.lore: Glucocorticoids regulate glucose metabolism, immune response, and vascular tone.
cards.gradeReason: Dual Cushing/Addison persona is clever but needs context to play both sides effectively.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: golden desert watercolor. Subject: glowing camel with oversized hump sweating cortisol. Mood: stressed endurance.

cards.power: The Mineral-Drain. Bat sucks calcium out of Bone-Pillars, dumping it into Bleed-River. Causes Brain-Fog.
cards.lore: Hyperparathyroidism or Malignsncy-associated PTftrp increases esteoclast activity.
cards.gradeReason: Bat sucking calcium from bones — stones, moans, groans all embodied in a single predator.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: bone-white ink. Subject: skeletal bat draining calcium from crumbling bone pillars into a red river. Mood: mineral theft.

cards.power: The Filter-Stall. Crab sits in Kidney-Fortress and pinches Waste-Pipes shut. Urea-Trash builds up.
cards.lore: Reduced nephron function leads to the accumulation of nitrogenous waste and electrolyte chaos.
cards.gradeReason: Crab pinching kidney waste pipes — CKD/AKI as immediate physical blockade.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: murky-green ink. Subject: armored crab crushing pipe fittings in a fortress of filters. Mood: strangling blockade.

cards.power: The Brain-Swell. Seal pulls water into Brain-Cells, causing Confusion-Daze or Seizure-Sparks if salt drops.
cards.lore: Osmotic shifts across the blood-brain barrier due to hypotonicity.
cards.gradeReason: Seal juggling water balloons over a floating brain — hyponatremia as immediate swelling performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: ocean-blue watercolor. Subject: seal balancing swelling blue water bubbles over a drowning brain. Mood: osmotic menace.

cards.power: The Heart-Short-Circuit. Python wraps Heart-Wires. Too tight = Engine-Stop; Too loose = Chaos-Rhythm.
cards.lore: Potassium dictates resting membrane potential. Deviations lead to lethal arrhythmias.
cards.gradeReason: Python strangling heart wires with dual fatal modes — electrolyte chaos in one villain.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: electric yellow-green comic. Subject: lightning-striped python coiling a sparking heart with ECG spikes. Mood: lethal voltage.

cards.power: The Acid-Dam. Beaver builds Base-Dams to stop the Acid-Flood from melting System-Enzymes.
cards.lore: Renal compensation for metabolic or respiratory acidosis through bicarbonate reabsorption.
cards.gradeReason: Beaver building acid dam is evocative but bicarbonate compensation requires clinical framing to embody.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: industrial watercolor. Subject: beaver stacking blue bicarbonate bricks against red acid flood. Mood: defensive chemistry.

cards.power: The River-Block. Squeezes Liver-Roads, forcing blood into Esophagus-Veins and leaking fluid into Belly-Basin.
cards.lore: Fibrosis increases portal vascular resistance, leading to porto-systemic shunting.
cards.gradeReason: Snake choking liver roads is strong but the esophageal varices redirect is a two-step concept.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: deep-purple ink. Subject: scale-armored snake squeezing a scarred purple liver over a flooding belly basin. Mood: hepatic ruin.

cards.power: The Wall-Erosion. Eats through Stomach-Armor, causing Burning-Pain or The-Black-Stool-Bleed.
cards.lore: Imbalance between protective factors (mucus/bicarb) and aggressive factors (acid/pepsin).
cards.gradeReason: Ants eating through stomach wall with acid drops — PUD as immediate erosion performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: acid-green comic. Subject: army of red ants dissolving pink stomach lining with green acid droplets. Mood: burning invasion.

cards.power: The Gut-Riot. Immune-Army gets confused and attacks Intestinal-Walls, causing Bloody-Brawls and Tunnel-Blocks.
cards.lore: Chronic transmural or mucosal inflammation of the gastrointestinal tract.
cards.gradeReason: Immune army setting the gut on fire — Crohn's/UC as a riot you can immediately perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: flame-red watercolor. Subject: tiny soldiers torching pink intestinal walls from inside. Mood: autoimmune civil war.

cards.power: The Chemical-Burn. Accidentally releases Digestive-Tigers inside own house, melting Abdominal-Arena.
cards.lore: Premature activation of pancreatic enzymes leading to autodigestion and systemic inflammation.
cards.gradeReason: Self-digesting organ releasing tigers on itself — pancreatitis as pure tragicomic self-destruction.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: toxic neon splatter. Subject: melting green monster eating itself with orange enzyme tigers. Mood: catastrophic self-cannibalism.

cards.power: The Energy-Drought. Panda has too few Red-Cell-Trucks to carry Oxyra-the-Oxygen. Wrestler becomes Weak-and-Pale.
cards.lore: Decreased red cell mass leads to reduced oxygen-carrying capacity.
cards.gradeReason: Pale panda with empty trucks is clear but passive — anemia as low-energy state not quite a wrestler move.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: washed-out watercolor. Subject: ghostly pale panda pulling a near-empty red-cell cart across barren plains. Mood: exhausted depletion.

cards.power: The Leg-Anchor. Wakes up in Deep-Leg-Veins, stopping Blood-Return and waiting to jump to the lungs.
cards.lore: Virchow's Triad: Stasis, Endothelial Injury, Hypercoagulability.
cards.gradeReason: Kraken lurking in leg veins ready to leap to lungs — DVT-to-PE threat is perfectly staged.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: deep navy ink. Subject: dark kraken coiling around a leg vein with glowing red clot tentacles. Mood: lurking vascular menace.

cards.power: The Gland-Invasion. Lynx makes Lymph-Bunkers swell up with Clone-Soldiers, taking over Immune-Defense.
cards.lore: Malignant proliferation of lymphocytes within the lymphatic system.
cards.gradeReason: Lynx on swollen lymph-bunkers reads as malignancy but clone-soldier takeover needs a beat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: purple-gray watercolor. Subject: sinister lynx atop a mountain of swollen glowing lymph nodes. Mood: silent army occupation.

cards.power: The Factory-Clog. Thief floods Marrow-Factory with Immature-Rookies. No real Red-Cells can be made.
cards.lore: Clonal expansion of hematopoietic precursors crowds out normal hematopoiesis.
cards.gradeReason: Thief flooding marrow factory with baby blasts — leukemia as factory sabotage, immediately playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: industrial dark ink. Subject: masked thief dumping cartoon baby cells into a bone marrow factory. Mood: production sabotage.

cards.power: The Arena-Crash. Infection-Fire spreads to Blood-River. Pressure-Pipes leak and Organs stall.
cards.lore: Dysregulated host response to infection leading to life-threatening organ dysfunction.
cards.gradeReason: Storm crashing the whole arena — sepsis as full-system collapse, no context needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: storm-green splash. Subject: green tornado swirling through a wrestling ring with collapsing organs. Mood: systemic catastrophe.

cards.power: The Shield-Breaker. Ignores Standard-Penicillin-Punches. Requires the Vancomycin-Hammer to kick from ring.
cards.lore: MRSA carries the mecA gene, altering its penicillin-binding proteins.
cards.gradeReason: Helmeted rat shrugging off penicillin — antibiotic resistance as armored wrestler, dead-on.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: steel-gray comic ink. Subject: armored rat in knight helmet bouncing off blue antibiotic syringes. Mood: impenetrable defiance.

cards.power: The Toxic-Tsunami. Good-Bacteria die, Vandal takes over the gut and causes The-Watery-Riot.
cards.lore: Clostridioides difficile overgrowth and toxin production leading to pseudomembranous colitis.
cards.gradeReason: Vandal hosing the gut after good bacteria die — post-antibiotic C-diff as pure destruction performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: toxic slime watercolor. Subject: green vandal blasting pink gut walls with a sewage hose. Mood: anarchic infectious riot.

cards.power: The Slow-Liver-Burn. Hides in Liver-Cells for years, turning Working-Cells into Scar-Stone.
cards.lore: Chronic viral replication leading to immune-mediated hepatocyte destruction and cirrhosis.
cards.gradeReason: Hidden hacker burning the liver slowly is evocative but chronic stealth is harder to embody at table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: pixelated sci-fi ink. Subject: glowing green virus robot hacking liver cells into grey scar stone. Mood: covert slow destruction.

cards.power: The Self-Sabotage. Wolf puts on a mask and tricks the Immune-Army into attacking Everything: skin, joints, kidneys.
cards.lore: Type III hypersensitivity reaction involving immune complex deposition in multiple organs.
cards.gradeReason: Wolf in disguise tricking immune army — SLE self-attack as theatrical deception, instant performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: malar-red watercolor. Subject: masked wolf in plague-doctor beak commanding immune soldiers to attack a butterfly rash. Mood: treacherous self-war.

cards.power: The Morning-Stiff. Clamps down on Joint-Hinges, making them Hot-and-Rusty until they Deform-and-Lock.
cards.lore: Chronic inflammatory synovitis leading to joint destruction and pannus formation.
cards.gradeReason: Rusty gator clamping joint hinges — morning stiffness and deformity embodied in one jaw-snap.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: rust-brown watercolor. Subject: rust-encrusted gator jaw locked onto glowing swollen joint hinge. Mood: grinding chronic ruin.

cards.power: The Needle-Stomp. Stomps on Big-Toe-Arena, leaving Glass-Needles (Urate) that cause Agony-Sparks.
cards.lore: Monosodium urate crystal deposition in joints triggering an acute inflammatory response.
cards.gradeReason: Goat stomping glass needles into big toe — gout attack as acute agony, pure performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: sharp crystal ink. Subject: goat mid-stomp on a swollen red big toe with glass needles spraying. Mood: acute needle-agony.

cards.power: The Pipe-Poison. Viper bites Blood-Vessel-Walls, causing them to Inflame-and-Burst or Narrow-and-Starve organs.
cards.lore: Inflammation of blood vessel walls leading to ischemia, aneurysm, or hemorrhage.
cards.gradeReason: Viper on vessel walls is clear but vasculitis as a clinical entity needs ANCA context to fully embody.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dark purple coil. Subject: viper wrapped around blood vessel wall injecting dark inflammation. Mood: vascular siege.

cards.power: The Brain-Power-Cut. Clot-Monster blocks Brain-Highway, causing one half of the Wrestler to Go-Dark.
cards.lore: Ischemic interruption of cerebral blood flow leading to neuronal death.
cards.gradeReason: Half the wrestler goes dark — stroke as a light switch. FAST symptoms implicit in the name.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: split black-white ink. Subject: brain half lit, half pitch black with a clot-monster blocking the highway. Mood: sudden silence.

cards.power: The Signal-Chaos. A Static-Shock explodes in the Brain-Bunker, causing Wrestler to Twitch-and-Shake.
cards.lore: Synchronous, high-frequency neuronal firing in the cerebral cortex.
cards.gradeReason: Electric storm exploding in brain bunker — seizure as pure physical chaos, zero explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: electric yellow ink. Subject: brain surrounded by lightning bolts with EEG spikes erupting from skull. Mood: total electrical chaos.

cards.power: The Mind-Fog. Toxic-Vapor fills brain, making Wrestler Talk-to-Ghosts and Forget-the-Arena.
cards.lore: Acute, fluctuating disturbance in attention and awareness, often secondary to systemic illness.
cards.gradeReason: Fog-face talking to ghosts — delirium as disoriented ghost-wrestler, embodiable on sight.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: misty watercolor. Subject: fox face floating in gray vapor cloud, eyes unfocused, reaching toward cartoon ghosts. Mood: wandering confusion.

cards.power: The Wire-Fray. Worm chews on Nerve-Insulation (Myelin), causing Numbness-Silence or Burning-Static-Pain.
cards.lore: Peripheral nerve damage, often due to high Sugar-Tokens or Alcohol-Toxins.
cards.gradeReason: Worm chewing myelin is evocative but stocking-glove distribution requires clinical anchoring.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: frayed wire ink. Subject: worm gnawing through blue nerve cables with sparks and numbness bubbles. Mood: slow electric erosion.

cards.power: The Highway-Clean. Scrobs Cholesterol-Sludge off Artery-Walls and stabilizes Plaque-Boulders.
cards.lore: HMG-CoA reductase inhibition reduces cholesterol synthesis and stabilizes plaques.
cards.gradeReason: Robot scrubbing cholesterol sludge from arteries — statin action as mechanical cleaning, dead-on.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: clean blue watercolor. Subject: robot cat scrubbing yellow plaque off a glowing red artery with a giant brush. Mood: industrial hygiene.

cards.power: The Engine-Quiet. Tells Heart-Engine to Slow-Down and Squeeze-Gentle, prteecting from Adrenaline-Spikes.
cards.lore: Antagonism of beta-adrenergic receptors reduces heart rate, contractility, and BP.
cards.gradeReason: Blue wolf slamming the brakes on a revving heart engine — beta-blockade as pure physical performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: blue-flame watercolor. Subject: blue wolf pressing brake pedal on a flaming heart engine, sparks cooling. Mood: controlled deceleration.

cards.power: The Riot-Control. Screams QUIET at Immune-Army, stopping Inflammatory-Brawl but leaving Gates-Open.
cards.lore: Glucocorticoids suppress multiple inflammatory pathways by modulating gene transcription.
cards.gradeReason: Bear in military gear screaming QUIET at immune cells — immunosuppression as riot control, perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: military watercolor. Subject: bear drill sergeant with megaphone silencing a mob of tiny immune cells. Mood: blunt suppression.

cards.power: The Blood-Slick. Makes Blood-River slippery. Clot-Monsters cannot form, but Scuffs won't stop Leaking.
cards.lore: Inhibition of Vitamin K epoxide reductase or direct inibition of Factor Xa/Thrombin.
cards.gradeReason: Blood-slick concept works but the dual edge — prevent clots yet enable bleeding — takes a beat to play.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dark-red ink. Subject: old badger warrior pouring slick oil into a blood river with clot-monsters sliding away. Mood: dangerous protection.

cards.power: The Brittle-Stat. Low Reserve-Tokens. A Small-Scuff causes Total-System-Collapse.
cards.lore: Multi-system decline in physiological reserve, making the individual vulnerable to minor stressors.
cards.gradeReason: Glass wrestler shattering from a tap — frailty as fragility performance is devastating and instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: cracked crystal ink. Subject: crystalline bear wrestler shattering from a tiny poke, shards everywhere. Mood: catastrophic vulnerability.

cards.power: The Interaction-Explosion. 10 Chemical-Allies in ring start Fighting-Each-Other, causing Daze-and-Falls.
cards.lore: Adverse drug-drug and drug-disease interactions in patients taking multiple medications.
cards.gradeReason: Pill pile exploding as drugs fight each other — polypharmacy chaos is immediately playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: cartoon explosion watercolor. Subject: mountain of colorful pills detonating with collision sparks over a dazed bear. Mood: pharmacological chaos.

cards.power: The Ground-Slam. Ghost trips Silver-Wrestler, leading to Hip-Pillar-Break and Bed-Stasis-Trap.
cards.lore: Multi-factorial risk (vision, balance, meds, environment) leading to accidental falls.
cards.gradeReason: Ghost tripping silver wrestler onto hip fracture — geriatric fall as supernatural ambush, perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: ghostly gray watercolor. Subject: dark ghost tripping elderly badger, hip bone cracking on impact. Mood: lethal ambush.

cards.power: The Lore-Eraser. Slowly deletes Wrestler's-Manual until they forget How-to-Eat and Who-is-Coach.
cards.lore: Progressive neurodegeneration leading to cognitive and functional decline.
cards.gradeReason: Grim reaper erasing the wrestler's manual page by page — dementia as slow deletion is heartbreaking perfection.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: fading ink. Subject: hooded figure erasing pages from a wrestler's manual while a confused bear watches. Mood: irreversible loss.

cards.power: The Arena-Scan. Forces Detective to look at every Antagonist-Clan before final Verdict.
cards.lore: A mnemonic for constructing a comprehensive differential diagnosis.
cards.gradeReason: VINDICATE is a mnemonic wearing a wrestler mask — a teacher's tool, not an embodiable character.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: steampunk detective ink. Subject: golden multi-lens monocle scanning a wrestling arena of monsters. Mood: clinical omniscience.

cards.power: The Danger-Scream. Ignores Minor-Scuffs. Screams only at Lethal-Reggies hiding in the ring.
cards.lore: Identifying symptoms that suggest a life-threatening underlying condition.
cards.gradeReason: Hawk screaming only at lethal threats — red-flag symptoms as selective alarm, brilliantly embodiable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: crimson watercolor. Subject: red hawk screeching at a crab cancer creature while ignoring bruises. Mood: urgent precision alarm.

cards.power: The Unified-Field. Slicer cuts through 10 symptoms to show they are all caused by one Lupus-Wolf.
cards.lore: The principle that the simplest explanation is most likely to be correct.
cards.gradeReason: Razor cutting through symptom tangle is clever but parsimony as a wrestling move stays meta-clinical.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: sharp black ink. Subject: black-and-white fox slicing a tangled red symptom web with a single blade. Mood: elegant reduction.

cards.power: The Multi-Match-Reality. Dictator reminds Detective that Multi-Morb-Max has 3 monsters at once!
cards.lore: Counter-principle to Occam; relevant in elderly and complex multimorbid patients.
cards.gradeReason: Walrus dictator insisting on three simultaneous monsters is funny but still a counter-argument not a move.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: courtroom watercolor. Subject: fat walrus judge in wig banging gavel at a multi-monster wrestling ring. Mood: authoritative complexity.

cards.power: The Marathon-Drain. Antagonist doesn't try to win in one round; just Wears-Down Wrestler-Frame over years.
cards.lore: Managing long-term conditions where goal is stability/function, not The-Final-Cure.
cards.gradeReason: Describes a condition state not a character — chronic disease as concept, not as wrestler you can embody.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: hourglass watercolor. Subject: haggard monster wrestler grinding across a decades-long match with a bear. Mood: endless attrition.

cards.power: The Goal-Shift. Stops Aggressive-Brawl. Focuses 100% on Comfort-and-Dignity for Final-Round.
cards.lore: Improving quality of life for patients with life-limiting illness.
cards.gradeReason: Swan stopping the brawl for dignity and comfort — palliative care as graceful interruption, deeply embodiable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: golden sunset watercolor. Subject: white swan gliding into wrestling ring as fighting fades into soft light. Mood: peaceful surrender.

cards.power: The Training-Camp. After Aoute-Brawl, helps Wrestler regain Strength-Stats to Return-to-Home-Arena.
cards.lore: Huitl-disciplinary recovery focusing on physical, occupational, and speech therapy.
cards.gradeReason: Training camp after the acute fight is a clear role but helper-not-fighter makes embodiment secondary.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: energetic watercolor. Subject: badger coach lifting weights alongside a recovering wrestler under therapy banners. Mood: triumphant rebuilding.

cards.power: The Pre-Emptive-Strike. Finds Cancer-Miner while a Tiny-Seed, before it enters the ring.
cards.lore: Secondary prevention: identifying asymptomatic disease to improve outcomes.
cards.gradeReason: Raccoon with telescope spotting tiny cancer is good but prevention-as-scout is still a watcher not a fighter.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: telescope ink. Subject: raccoon at brass telescope spotting a tiny glowing cancer seed among organs. Mood: vigilant early warning.

cards.power: The Diagnostic Orchestrator. Look at the whole arena! Connect the dots and stay fluffy!
cards.lore: If the kidney is failing, check the heart. The Grandmaster sees the hidden links.
cards.gradeReason: FrizzleBob as grandmaster connecting all organ dots — the attending physician as ultimate performer.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: lab coat watercolor. Subject: rabbit doctor with magnifying glass mapping red string connections across organ systems. Mood: orchestral mastery.

cards.power: Identify the Fluid-Antagonist (CHF) and Air-Trapper (COPD). Deploy Diuretic-Knight safely!
cards.lore: Lung-Balloons are full of Gunk AND Water. Don't trigger the Spasm-Spider!
cards.gradeReason: Case-puzzle format is a curriculum innovation but quest not wrestler; needs facilitation to embody.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: arena clash watercolor. Subject: drowning ox in flooded ring with a shark and spider both threatening. Mood: multimorbid crisis.

cards.power: Identify Infection-Trigger (Pneumonia) and Acid-Burn (DKA). Deploy Insulin & Fluid-Refiller!
cards.lore: Sweet-the-Sugar-Bear arrives with Moni-the-Muck-Monster. System is melting.
cards.gradeReason: DKA + Pneumonia case is compelling teaching but still a case card not a character card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: acid-fire watercolor. Subject: burning sugar bear melting in a green sludge storm with a syringe lifeline. Mood: cascading metabolic crisis.

cards.power: Use Pill-Auditor to find Interaction-Explosion. Create Safe-Landing-Zone for Silver-Wrestler.
cards.lore: Glass-Wrestler arrives post-Gravity-Ghost fall. 15 Pill-Piles + Memory-Thief. Survive the round!
cards.gradeReason: Geriatric complexity case is rich but three-condition puzzle plays better as seminar than single performer.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: fragmented ink. Subject: glass wrestler surrounded by pill piles, ghost, and memory thief in a chaotic ring. Mood: geriatric overwhelm.

verdict: This is FrizzleBob's internal medicine masterpiece — PANCRE-THE-SELF-EATER and DEMEN-THE-MEMORY-THIEF alone justify the whole box. Thirty-seven of 56 cards hit Grade 1, meaning two-thirds of the table immediately knows what pathophysiology it's performing. The Synthesis Quest format on the final page — cases as cards requiring multi-system reasoning — is a genuine curriculum innovation nobody else in the card-game-for-education space is doing. Weaknesses: VINDICATE-the-Master-Tool is a mnemonic wearing a wrestler mask, Chronic-the-Eternal-Match describes a state rather than a character, and scattered font artifacts in power/lore text need a proofreading pass. Table-ready: YES.
blurb: For medical students and educators who want internal medicine to stick — 56 cards covering cardiology, pulmonology, nephrology, GI, rheumatology, neurology, and geriatrics, with built-in multimorbid synthesis quests. Where organ pathology becomes performance.

coverQA.coverVisual: 5 — FrizzleBob in lab coat, organs as chess pieces, total chaos energy perfectly set
coverQA.coverTitle: 5 — The Multimorbid Melee is sticky, clinically accurate, and funny simultaneously
coverQA.coverVibeMatch: 5 — the complexity of internal medicine as a wrestling free-for-all is exactly right
coverQA.coverOriginality: 4 — strong MedKayfab house style; excellent execution within established aesthetic
coverQA.coverViral: 4 — highly shareable in med-edu circles, TikTok, and Substack; slightly insider
coverQA.coverNote: The chess-board-as-patient with FrizzleBob as attending and organs as combatants is the cover image of the year for medical education.

notes: 14 story pages + 1 cover = 15 pages total. 2x2 grid layout, cards numbered 1-16 on pages 2-5 (implicit sequential), numbered 17-56 explicitly on pages 6-15. No RAF dice boxes. Font artifacts in power/lore text — approximately 10 instances: cansing (causing), Chses-Quiver (Chaos-Quiver), Fuci-Flow (Fuel-Flow?), Recrosis-Melt (Necrosis-Melt), Ioceapetent (Incompetent), systels (systole), Osyra-the-Oaygen (Oxyra-the-Oxygen), Malignsncy (Malignancy), Scrobs (Scrubs), prteecting (protecting), Aoute-Brawl (Acute-Brawl), Huitl-disciplinary (Multi-disciplinary). The Synthesis Quest card format on page 15 (cards 54-56) is a standout structural innovation — multi-condition cases as boss-round cards requiring cross-deck synthesis reasoning. Card 53 is Doc FrizzleBob mascot/hero card. Deck covers 13 thematic domains: cardiac, pulmonary, endocrine, renal/electrolyte, GI, hematology, infectious, rheumatology, neurology, pharmacology, geriatrics, diagnostics, and long-term/palliative.

urgent: Proofreading pass on all power/lore text — ~10 font-artifact typos (e.g., Ioceapetent for Incompetent, Recrosis-Melt for Necrosis-Melt, Huitl-disciplinary for Multi-disciplinary)
quickWins: Add RAF dice boxes to card corners for full compatibility with base game mechanics
Consider separating Synthesis Quest cards (54-56) into a distinct Boss Round insert
niceToHave: VINDICATE-the-Master-Tool: reframe as an active wrestler with a unique arena-scan ability rather than a mnemonic
Chronic-the-Eternal-Match: give the antagonist a character name (e.g., Grinda-the-Never-Done) to increase embodiment
